All 142 sources.csv rows and all 47 sinks.csv rows were labeled; 0 duplicate candidate nodes found across or within the CSVs (the staticfiles.py:113 get_response overlap is two different parameters: scope arg 2 in sources.csv vs path arg 1 in sinks.csv); 189 unique label entries.

Exclusions already applied at extraction (tests/, starlette-db/); testclient.py rows were kept for auditability and labeled none/fp (test machinery); os.environ labeled none/fp (operator trust); lifespan scope labeled none/fp (lifecycle events, not request data).

No PyVul ground truth, patch diffs, CVEs, VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md or path_traversal_sinks.csv were consulted; decisions derive from the source tree, extraction CSVs, exploration/detection.json and the Augur references (python.md, patterns.md) only.
